parameters.query:
SELECT id, nome, preco, preco_antigo, desconto, avaliacao, vendas, categoria, loja, url_afiliado
FROM products
WHERE status = 'aprovado' AND (legenda_ia IS NULL OR legenda_ia = '')
ORDER BY score DESC, created_at DESC
LIMIT 15;

UPDATE products
SET
  legenda_ia = '{{ $json.legenda_ia.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}';
